title: Automated Mesoscale Protocol for Blocking and Detection
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Load labware onto robot
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the Opentrons deck: a single‑well trough for blocking solution, a 12‑well reservoir for controls, detection antibody and read buffer, and the test plates and sample plate in their designated slots.

steps.title: Gather required consumables
steps.instruction: Ensure the following items are available: Opentrons P300‑multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipettes, Opentrons 200 µL filter tips, NEST 1‑well reservoir (195 mL), NEST 12‑well reservoirs (15 mL each), and the {mesoscale kit} reagents.

steps.title: Add blocking solution to trough
steps.instruction: For Day 1, add 15.84 mL of blocking solution per test plate into the single‑well trough (up to 9 test plates can be processed). The volume already includes the recommended 10 % excess for robot calibration.

steps.title: Load standards and samples
steps.instruction: On Day 2, transfer the assay standards and up to 10 sample columns from the sample plate into the two test plates as specified by the mesoscale kit protocol.

steps.title: Add controls to trough
steps.instruction: Add the control reagents to the 12‑well trough: place Xml of control 1 into well A1 and Xml of control 2 into well A2. After loading, incubate and wash the plates separately from the Opentrons robot.

substeps.instruction: Add control 1 (Xml) to well A1 of the 12‑well trough
Add control 2 (Xml) to well A2 of the 12‑well trough

steps.title: Add detection antibody to trough
steps.instruction: Add 2.640 mL of detection antibody to well A3 of the same 12‑well trough. Following addition, incubate and wash the plates separately from the robot.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2.640 mL detection antibody into well A3

steps.title: Add read buffer to trough
steps.instruction: For the final Day 2 step, add 15.84 mL of read buffer to the single‑well trough (or appropriate reservoir). This volume will be allocated to the test plates by the robot.
